Alex — thanks for the heads up on timing. I can do Thu 8/13 at 11:00am PDT and have reserved that slot tentatively. I attached an .ics for the Redwood demo (redwood_demo_calendar.ics).

Short answers to your trial/residency questions:
- Data residency: yes — we can route logs and audit exports to US or EU regions for accounts on Dedicated/Private.
- Trial/POC: we offer a 14-day evaluation for self-serve workloads and a 30-day POC for Dedicated/Private incl. baseline throughput targets; POC scoping is typically 1–2 weeks and Ben will scope with you on the call.

Ben will take the procurement/contracting thread during the demo. If you want, add any sample payloads to the HubSpot deal record so our evaluation team can prep latency numbers ahead of time: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/LDG-20260807-01

Regards,
Grace
